{"schema": "alpaca-verify-verdict/1", "verification": "vf-t-193-82943", "slot": "v2", "round": 0,
 "audit_event": null,
 "summary": "Re-ran all four frozen gate items (build, source, unit, metric:total_bytes) on tree/ through bin/rerun --gate: each ended PASS rc 0, the unit gate passed 22 cases and the metric gate produced total_bytes 101578 on all three repeats. The empty diff applied with rc 0 and no output. The seven local evidence copies re-hash to their sealed sha256; the two event pointers replay with matching chain hashes through --event (a raw --hash of the event file bytes does not equal the chain hash, as expected for an event). Event 82939 records outcome baseline, which the tree's state.attempt_verdict maps to verdict baseline via types.VERDICT_OF; event 82935 records accepted true, phase baseline. The deficit score -0.154295454545 equals (88000-101578)/88000 for the contract target 88000. All claims supported.",
 "claims": [
  {"id": "s1", "verdict": "supported", "reason": null,
   "evidence": [
    {"receipt": "ev-82939", "observed": "research-attempt event 82939 replays with match true; data has key rr-004:r0:s0, round 0, outcome baseline, gates build/source/unit/metric all PASS, tamper points open/after-eval/close PASS"},
    {"receipt": "ev-82935", "observed": "research-accept event 82935 (id lower than 82939, ts 18:46:04 vs 18:46:05) replays with match true: phase baseline, outcome baseline, accepted true"},
    {"read": "tree/alpaca/research/types.py", "observed": "VERDICT_OF maps outcome baseline to verdict baseline; proofs.py renders the glance line from state.attempt_verdict"}],
   "failure_scenario": "a second research-attempt event for t-193 exists in the record, so the attempt was not recorded only once",
   "note": "Verdict word baseline is derived from outcome baseline (state.attempt_verdict -> _verdict_of). Ordering: fingerprints taken 18:46:01/04/05, accept event 82935 before attempt event 82939."},
  {"id": "r1", "verdict": "supported", "reason": null,
   "evidence": [{"receipt": "g-build", "observed": "gate build on side tree: verdict PASS, rc 0, log shows only the jail start line (compile ran clean)"}],
   "failure_scenario": "toyzip.py compiles under the jail python but has a syntax form a different python3 version rejects",
   "note": "Re-ran the frozen build gate with --gate build --side tree."},
  {"id": "r2", "verdict": "supported", "reason": null,
   "evidence": [{"receipt": "g-source", "observed": "gate source on side tree: verdict PASS, rc 0, log 'source gate passed (2661 bytes)', same as sealed log 02"}],
   "failure_scenario": "the source check reads a stale toyzip.py copy rather than the worktree file it names",
   "note": "Re-ran the frozen source gate with --gate source --side tree."},
  {"id": "r3", "verdict": "supported", "reason": null,
   "evidence": [{"receipt": "g-unit", "observed": "gate unit on side tree: verdict PASS, rc 0, log ends '22 cases passed', identical case list to sealed log 03"}],
   "failure_scenario": "the unit round-trip cases pass yet a corpus file outside the 22 cases fails to round-trip",
   "note": "Re-ran the frozen unit gate with --gate unit --side tree."},
  {"id": "r4", "verdict": "supported", "reason": null,
   "evidence": [{"receipt": "g-metric", "observed": "gate metric:total_bytes on side tree: verdict PASS, rc 0, three repeat logs each with METRIC total_bytes 101578"}],
   "failure_scenario": "the metric gate passes on markers alone while the measured program crashed after printing them",
   "note": "Re-ran the frozen metric gate with --gate metric:total_bytes --side tree."},
  {"id": "r5", "verdict": "supported", "reason": null,
   "evidence": [{"receipt": "g-metric", "observed": "verify-1-1, verify-1-2 and verify-1-3 logs each report total_bytes 101578, so median 101578 from 3 successful repeats"},
                {"receipt": "ev-82939", "observed": "metrics.total_bytes: median 101578.0, n_ok 3, repeats [101578.0,101578.0,101578.0]"}],
   "failure_scenario": "the measurement is non-deterministic and a fresh run on another machine gives a different byte total",
   "note": "Fresh repeats match the recorded repeats exactly; the metric is declared deterministic in the contract."},
  {"id": "r6", "verdict": "supported", "reason": null,
   "evidence": [{"receipt": "ev-82935", "observed": "accept event: phase baseline, outcome baseline, reason 'baseline measured: deficit score -0.154295454545', score -0.15429545454545454"},
                {"read": "packet/research-contract.json", "observed": "metric total_bytes target 88000, direction lower; (88000-101578)/88000 = -0.1542954545"}],
   "failure_scenario": "the deficit score uses a target other than the frozen 88000, so the logged score does not follow from the contract",
   "note": "Checked the score by hand against the contract target and the re-measured value 101578."},
  {"id": "r7", "verdict": "supported", "reason": null,
   "evidence": [{"receipt": "apply", "observed": "git apply --allow-empty of packet/diff.patch rc 0, no output; diff.patch is 0 bytes with sha256 e3b0c442... (the empty-input hash)"},
                {"receipt": "ev-82939", "observed": "diff: path .alpaca/research/rr-004/attempts/t-193/attempt.diff, bytes 0, empty true"}],
   "failure_scenario": "the packet copy is empty but the live attempt.diff held content that was never copied",
   "note": "The brief's sealed sha256 for the diff equals the sha256 of zero bytes."},
  {"id": "r8", "verdict": "supported", "reason": null,
   "evidence": [{"receipt": "ev-82939", "observed": "attempt event outcome baseline (its data field verdict is PASS, the gate/tamper verdict)"},
                {"read": "tree/alpaca/research/state.py", "observed": "attempt_verdict sets verdict=_verdict_of(outcome); VERDICT_OF['baseline'] is 'baseline'; no research-verify-end alters it here"}],
   "failure_scenario": "a later verify-end event of t-193 rewrites the attempt verdict to broken or rejected before the report is read",
   "note": "The report's verdict word comes from VERDICT_OF on the recorded outcome, not the event's PASS field."},
  {"id": "h1", "verdict": "supported", "reason": null,
   "evidence": [{"receipt": "g-build", "observed": "build PASS rc 0"},
                {"receipt": "g-source", "observed": "source PASS rc 0"},
                {"receipt": "g-unit", "observed": "unit PASS rc 0, 22 cases passed"},
                {"receipt": "g-metric", "observed": "metric:total_bytes PASS rc 0, 101578 x3"}],
   "failure_scenario": "the reproduce blocks name commands that differ from what the gate jail actually executes from the frozen contract",
   "note": "Each of the four gate blocks re-ran with --gate on side tree and reproduced the recorded result."},
  {"id": "e1", "verdict": "supported", "reason": null,
   "evidence": [{"receipt": "h-e1", "observed": "rehash of packet/evidence/01-attempt-1-1.log: match true, sha256 0609596...28a5, 25 bytes"}],
   "failure_scenario": "the build log copy was swapped for another build log with identical jail-start content",
   "note": "Copy matches the sealed hash; content agrees with my fresh build gate log."},
  {"id": "e2", "verdict": "supported", "reason": null,
   "evidence": [{"receipt": "h-e2", "observed": "rehash of packet/evidence/02-attempt-1-1.log: match true, sha256 0b10755...2f1d, 57 bytes"}],
   "failure_scenario": "the sealed source log came from an earlier attempt on a different toyzip.py of the same size",
   "note": "Copy matches the sealed hash; content equals my fresh source gate log."},
  {"id": "e3", "verdict": "supported", "reason": null,
   "evidence": [{"receipt": "h-e3", "observed": "rehash of packet/evidence/03-attempt-1-1.log: match true, sha256 ab42552...554d, 607 bytes"}],
   "failure_scenario": "the unit log copy is genuine but belongs to the champion run of another task",
   "note": "Copy matches the sealed hash; case list equals my fresh unit gate log."},
  {"id": "e4", "verdict": "supported", "reason": null,
   "evidence": [{"receipt": "h-e4", "observed": "rehash of packet/evidence/04-attempt-1-3.log: match true, sha256 3081656...6296, 158 bytes, METRIC total_bytes 101578"}],
   "failure_scenario": "only repeat 3 is sealed, and repeats 1 and 2 recorded different values than the event claims",
   "note": "Copy matches the sealed hash; value agrees with my three fresh repeats."},
  {"id": "e5", "verdict": "supported", "reason": null,
   "evidence": [{"receipt": "h-e5", "observed": "rehash of packet/evidence/05-open.json: match true, sha256 fa67826...4b43, 563343 bytes"}],
   "failure_scenario": "the open fingerprint was taken after the worktree was already modified, hiding a pre-gate change",
   "note": "Copy matches the sealed hash; point open, errors empty."},
  {"id": "e6", "verdict": "supported", "reason": null,
   "evidence": [{"receipt": "h-e6", "observed": "rehash of packet/evidence/06-after-eval.json: match true, sha256 5cb987d...19a5, 563349 bytes"}],
   "failure_scenario": "the after-eval fingerprint omits files the gates could have written, so tampering there goes unseen",
   "note": "Copy matches the sealed hash; point after-eval, errors empty."},
  {"id": "e7", "verdict": "supported", "reason": null,
   "evidence": [{"receipt": "h-e7", "observed": "rehash of packet/evidence/07-close.json: match true, sha256 451b41c...7b2a, 563344 bytes"}],
   "failure_scenario": "the close fingerprint was written by the builder from the open file rather than taken fresh",
   "note": "Copy matches the sealed hash; point close, errors empty."},
  {"id": "e8", "verdict": "supported", "reason": null,
   "evidence": [{"receipt": "ev-82939", "observed": "event replay of packet/events/82939.json: match true, hash 2548c853...c321 equals the sealed sha256, prev_hash 5340d220..."}],
   "failure_scenario": "the exported event JSON matches its chain hash but the live record row was later altered",
   "note": "Event pointers are checked by --event replay; a byte --hash of the export (receipt h-e8) gives a different digest because the chain hash covers the canonical event, not the file bytes."},
  {"id": "e9", "verdict": "supported", "reason": null,
   "evidence": [{"receipt": "ev-82935", "observed": "event replay of packet/events/82935.json: match true, hash eaa79670...b108 equals the sealed sha256"}],
   "failure_scenario": "the accept event replays but a later accept event for t-193 supersedes it in the record",
   "note": "Checked by --event replay; byte --hash (h-e9) differs as expected for an exported event."},
  {"id": "x1", "verdict": "supported", "reason": null,
   "evidence": [{"receipt": "apply", "observed": "git apply --binary --allow-empty ../packet/diff.patch in tree: rc 0, empty output, patch 0 bytes"},
                {"read": "packet/diff.patch", "observed": "file is 0 bytes; sealed sha256 e3b0c442...b855 is the empty hash"}],
   "failure_scenario": "tree/ is not at d01a3be8 so the empty patch applied cleanly to the wrong commit",
   "conditions": [{"id": "k1", "check": "tree/ and base/ packs folders are identical after the apply, and toyzip.py hash equals the fingerprint entry", "ran": true, "receipt": "apply", "passed": true}],
   "note": "diff -rq tree/packs base/packs showed no difference; toyzip.py sha256 13757c83... matches the open fingerprint entry."},
  {"id": "x2", "verdict": "supported", "reason": null,
   "evidence": [{"receipt": "g-build", "observed": "build PASS rc 0"},
                {"receipt": "g-source", "observed": "source PASS rc 0"},
                {"receipt": "g-unit", "observed": "unit PASS rc 0"},
                {"receipt": "g-metric", "observed": "metric:total_bytes PASS rc 0"},
                {"receipt": "ev-82939", "observed": "gates list in the event: build PASS, source PASS, unit PASS, metric:total_bytes PASS"}],

   "evidence": [{"receipt": "g-metric", "observed": "three fresh repeats all total_bytes 101578, so median 101578.0"}],
   "failure_scenario": "the median rule is 'worse' and would pick a different value had the repeats differed, masking a recording bug",
   "note": "Re-ran the metric gate; repeats and median match the record."},
  {"id": "x3", "verdict": "supported", "reason": null,
   "evidence": [{"receipt": "ev-82935", "observed": "accept event: accepted true, outcome baseline, phase baseline, champion_score null"},
                {"receipt": "ev-82939", "observed": "metrics total_bytes median 101578.0, n_ok 3, spread 0.0, untested false; champion_metrics {}"},

  {"id": "x5", "verdict": "supported", "reason": null,
   "evidence": [{"receipt": "ev-82939", "observed": "tamper: points [open, after-eval, close], verdict PASS"},
                {"receipt": "h-e5", "observed": "open fingerprint matches sealed hash; errors []"},
                {"receipt": "h-e6", "observed": "after-eval fingerprint matches sealed hash; errors []"},
                {"receipt": "h-e7", "observed": "close fingerprint matches sealed hash; errors []"}],
   "failure_scenario": "the three fingerprints differ in an entry the tamper check ignores, so PASS hides a change",
   "note": "Stripped the trailing point/taken_at fields: the entries sections of open, after-eval and close are byte-identical (cmp rc 0), each errors list empty."}
 ]}
